excerpt: Applying HHL, least-squares fitting, qPCA, support vector machines, and related methods to classical data begins by loading large data sets into a quantum system, which can require exponential time without qRAM.
overview: This passage is the strongest limit on headline speedup claims for classical data. It separates quantum processing time from the end-to-end pipeline cost and explains why input and output assumptions can dominate practical performance.
title: Input Output qRAM Bottleneck
